youtube.aciklama: An exostosis is a benign bony growth in the bony part of the ear canal, close to the eardrum. It is linked to repeated contact with cold water and is common in surfing, swimming and diving, so it is also called surfer's ear.

bilgiler: An exostosis is a benign bony growth near the eardrum.
It is linked to repeated cold-water contact; it is called surfer's ear.
Unless the canal narrows markedly, hearing is usually normal.

cumleler: How is cold water linked to bony growths in the ear?
An exostosis is a benign bony growth near the eardrum.
It is linked to repeated cold-water contact, often in both ears.
Common in surfing, swimming and diving, it is called surfer's ear.
Unless the canal narrows markedly, hearing is usually normal.
Wax and water can get trapped; a blockage causes conductive loss.
